thread_created: The game thread has been created. Waiting for game output.
environment_failed: Startup settings failed. Details are in the diagnostic log.
graphics_failed: Graphics setup failed. Details are in the diagnostic log.
runtime_failed: Game runtime setup failed. Details are in the diagnostic log.
runtime_error: The runtime reported an error. Details are in the diagnostic log.
audio_unavailable: The audio system could not be initialized. The game was not started. Details are in the diagnostic log.
spatial_audio_unavailable: Gate-card accessibility sounds are unavailable. Details are in the diagnostic log.
settings_unavailable: The expanded settings menu is unavailable. Details are in the diagnostic log.
settings_save_failed_on_exit: Some settings could not be saved before closing the game.
settings_apply_failed_on_exit: Some settings could not be applied before closing the game.
launch_failed: The game could not be started. Details are in the diagnostic log.
process_failed: The game process stopped with an error. Details are in the diagnostic log.
early_exit: The process ended before creating the game thread. Details are in the diagnostic log.
missing_files: The diagnostic installation is incomplete. The game was not started.
storage_failed: The launcher's files or writable storage could not be opened. The game was not started.
log_failed: Writing the diagnostic log failed. The launcher is still monitoring the game.
speech_unavailable: Automatic speech is unavailable. Status messages remain available as text.
already_running: A diagnostic launch is already running.
keyboard_hints: Type text. Enter confirms. Escape cancels. Tab moves between the text field and buttons.

creator_descriptions.creator_2_0: Tall, uneven spikes rise above the forehead and along the sides.
creator_descriptions.creator_2_1: Short, pointed locks sweep across the forehead.
creator_descriptions.creator_2_2: Cropped sides with a smooth top swept forward into a short point.
creator_descriptions.creator_2_3: Shaggy layers hang over the forehead and around the ears.
creator_descriptions.creator_2_4: A narrow strip of upright spikes runs along the center, with shaved sides.
creator_descriptions.creator_2_5: A large, rounded puff with a scalloped lower edge.
creator_descriptions.creator_2_6: Hair is clipped close to the scalp all over.
creator_descriptions.creator_2_7: Parallel braids run from the forehead to the back of the head.
creator_descriptions.creator_6_0: Closed lips form a narrow line.
creator_descriptions.creator_6_1: Defined upper and lower lips with a fuller outline.
creator_descriptions.creator_8_2: Thin frames with rounded, oval lenses.
creator_descriptions.creator_8_3: A wide, close-fitting band of lenses wraps across the eyes.
creator_descriptions.creator_8_4: Large lenses taper toward the cheeks, joined by a narrow bridge.
creator_descriptions.creator_11_1: A rounded crown with a forward-facing visor.
creator_descriptions.creator_11_2: A close-fitting cap with bands around its lower edge.
creator_descriptions.creator_11_3: A soft crown with a brim that slopes down around the head.
creator_descriptions.creator_11_4: A low, rounded crown above a short front peak.
creator_descriptions.creator_11_5: A creased crown with a broad, curled brim and a chin cord.
creator_descriptions.creator_13_0: A short-sleeved open jacket over a high-necked top.
creator_descriptions.creator_13_1: A sleeveless hooded zip-front layer over a short-sleeved shirt.
creator_descriptions.creator_13_2: A short-sleeved crew-neck shirt with an emblem on the chest.
creator_descriptions.creator_13_3: A sleeveless top with broad shoulder straps and contrasting side panels.
creator_descriptions.creator_13_4: A fitted, long-sleeved jacket with wide folded lapels and pockets.
creator_descriptions.creator_13_5: A short-sleeved wrap-front top with broad diagonal trim and a tie at the waist.
creator_descriptions.creator_16_0: Full-length, straight legs with stripes down the sides.
creator_descriptions.creator_16_1: Loose, knee-length legs with large side pockets and gathered cuffs.
creator_descriptions.creator_16_2: Full-length legs with front pockets and a slightly flared hem.
creator_descriptions.creator_16_3: Full-length, loose legs with broad turned-up cuffs.
creator_descriptions.creator_16_4: Fitted legs with a wide belt, large buckle, and hanging side straps.
creator_descriptions.creator_16_5: Loose, knee-length legs with a tie at the waist.
creator_descriptions.creator_19_0: Low-cut shoes with broad panels across the front and a thick sole.
creator_descriptions.creator_19_1: Thick-soled ankle boots with broad fastenings across the front.
creator_descriptions.creator_19_2: High-top shoes with a broad strap across the instep and a flat sole.
creator_descriptions.creator_19_3: Calf-high boots with straps around the shaft and a thick sole.
creator_descriptions.creator_19_4: High boots with front fastenings and a heavy treaded sole.
creator_descriptions.creator_19_5: Low-cut slip-on shoes with a strap across the top and a raised heel.
creator_descriptions.creator_21_1: A segmented cuff reaches along the forearm; the fingers are left exposed.
creator_descriptions.creator_21_2: A short glove covers the back of the hand and leaves the fingers exposed.
creator_descriptions.creator_21_3: A padded back-of-hand panel and wrist wrap, with fingers exposed.
creator_descriptions.creator_21_4: A fitted glove covers the entire hand and all fingers.
creator_descriptions.creator_21_5: A studded wrist strap and padded back-of-hand panels, with fingers exposed.
